name: Caddy
description: A web server that obtains and renews its own TLS certificates.

env.label: Site address
env.description: Only read if you pass the environment-variable form of the config below. With a real domain here Caddy fetches a certificate on first start.

notes: With no config file Caddy serves a welcome page. Mount a Caddyfile at /etc/caddy/Caddyfile to serve anything real.
